rules.law_name: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.title: Berkeley rent-control coverage
rules.requirement: Berkeley rent control applies to units the guide lists as fully covered, such as most multifamily properties built before 1980, certain pre-1996 single-family tenancies, and qualifying rooming houses. Units listed as partially covered are registered and have just-cause and security-deposit-interest coverage, but do not have rent control under this guide.

coverage.other_unresolvable: Rent-control coverage depends on unit type, construction or certificate-of-occupancy timing, tenancy start date for single-family homes, rooming-house lease structure, condominium status, and specified subsidy and HUD mortgage facts.
coverage.summary: Rent control is shown as applying to fully covered Berkeley units, including most multifamily units built before 1980, single-family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996, and single-family rooming houses with five or more rooms rented separately.

rules.exemptions: Not rent-controlled under the guide: new construction built and receiving a certificate of occupancy after June 1980; single-family homes with tenancies beginning on or after January 1, 1996; most condominiums; specified subsidized units listed as partially covered; and fully exempt units such as Golden Duplexes, owner-shared kitchen/bath units meeting the stated condition, certain post-November 7, 2018 ADU/owner-occupied properties, university rental units, and nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.interaction: The guide distinguishes fully covered units, which have rent control, just-cause eviction protection, and security-deposit interest, from partially covered units, which do not have rent control but do have the other listed protections.

rules.law_name: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.title: Berkeley just-cause eviction coverage
rules.requirement: If a Berkeley unit is listed as fully covered or partially covered in this guide, the ordinance’s just-cause-for-eviction protection applies. Units listed as exempt have no just-cause-for-eviction coverage under this guide.

coverage.other_unresolvable: Coverage and exemptions depend on unit type, tenancy start date, construction or certificate-of-occupancy timing, subsidy and HUD mortgage status, historical and current owner occupancy, owner sharing of kitchen or bath, ADU status, university rental status, and nonprofit cooperative status.
coverage.summary: Just-cause eviction protection is shown as applying to both fully covered and partially covered Berkeley units, including many multifamily units, single-family homes, rooming houses, new construction, condominiums, and specified subsidized units.

rules.exemptions: Exempt units with no just-cause coverage are listed as: Golden Duplexes; units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant if the owner lived on the property when the tenancy started; tenancies started after November 7, 2018 on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied; university rental units such as dormitories; and nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.interaction: The guide states that partially covered units lack rent control but still have just-cause-for-eviction and security-deposit-interest coverage.

rules.title: Berkeley security-deposit interest coverage

coverage.other_unresolvable: Coverage and exemptions depend on unit type, tenancy start date, construction or certificate-of-occupancy timing, subsidy and HUD mortgage status, historical and current owner occupancy, owner sharing of kitchen or bath, ADU status, university rental status, and nonprofit cooperative status.
coverage.summary: Security-deposit-interest coverage is shown as applying to both fully covered and partially covered Berkeley units, including many multifamily units, single-family homes, rooming houses, new construction, condominiums, and specified subsidized units.

rules.exemptions: Exempt units with no security-deposit-interest coverage are listed as: Golden Duplexes; units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant if the owner lived on the property when the tenancy started; tenancies started after November 7, 2018 on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied; university rental units such as dormitories; and nonprofit cooperatives.
